title: Pure Predaplant
summary: Pure Predaplant and Starving Venom Fusion build, updated with the 2026 Predaplant wave, Polymerization, Super Polymerization and generic staples. Predator Counters drop opposing monsters to Level 1 to disrupt Xyz and Synchro math while turning them into tribute fodder and Fusion material.

summary.title: Starters
points: Predaplant Longinephila (2026 Tuner) searches any Predap card when Normal or Special Summoned, and banishes itself from the GY to place a Predator Counter or Set Polymerization from the GY.

Predaplant Ophrys Scorpio discards a monster on Normal or Special Summon to Special Summon Predaplant Darlingtonia Cobra from the Deck, which searches Polymerization, Super Polymerization or Predaprime Fusion.
Predaprimitive (2026 Spell) mills a Predap card (such as Predaplant Byblisp, which searches any Predaplant monster when sent to the GY) and searches a Polymerization or Fusion Spell.

summary.title: Opening: Ophrys Scorpio or Longinephila
steps: Summon Predaplant Ophrys Scorpio and discard a monster (ideally Byblisp) to Special Summon Predaplant Darlingtonia Cobra from the Deck; Cobra searches Polymerization and Byblisp searches Predaplant Bufolicula or Predaplant Lilizard.

Alternatively, Normal Summon Predaplant Longinephila to search Predapractice or Predaprimitive, Special Summon Predaplant Lilizard beside it to add Polymerization from the Deck or GY, and Fusion Summon Predaplant Ambulomelides.

Ambulomelides searches Predaplanning or a Pendulum Predaplant on Fusion Summon, then Tributes a monster with a Predator Counter (or one of your Predaplants) to Special Summon a Predaplant from the Deck.
Fuse or Synchro climb into Predaplant Dragostapelia, Starving Venom Predapower Fusion Dragon or the Level 7 Synchro Tuner Predaplant Bal Teah, with Predaplanning Set.

summary.title: Predator Counters & Board Breakers
points: Predaplant Daredevil (newest Extra Deck monster) Special Summons itself by Tributing a monster with a Predator Counter on either field and destroys opposing Spells and Traps.

Predaplant Chlamydosundew fuses a DARK Fusion Monster using monsters with Predator Counters on the opponent's field as material, while Predaplant Bufolicula and Predaplant Triantis fuse from the Pendulum Zones and spread counters when used as material.
Super Polymerization and Predaprime Fusion fuse away the opponent's DARK or countered monsters at Quick-Play speed on either turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Predaplant Dragostapelia places a Predator Counter on an opponent's monster as a Quick Effect and continuously negates the activated effects of all opposing monsters with Predator Counters.
Starving Venom Predapower Fusion Dragon Tributes a monster with a Predator Counter on either field to negate any card or effect activation.
Predaplant Bal Teah (2026 Synchro Tuner) revives a Predaplant or Starving Venom monster and performs a Fusion Summon when the opponent Special Summons.

Starving Venom Fusion Dragon copies a Level 5 or higher monster's name and effects and wipes Special Summoned monsters when destroyed, while Thorn Fangs of Violet Poison lets Starving Venom destroy weaker monsters and burn.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Predaplant Verte Anaconda and Supreme King Dragon Starving Venom are Forbidden in the TCG. Starving Venom Wing Dragon requires a Clear Wing monster, Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons releases in the TCG on 12 November 2026, and the page's Branded and Rose Dragon sub-engines are omitted for a pure Predaplant list.

exclude.Starving Venom Wing Dragon: Needs a Clear Wing monster as material.
exclude.Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, Four Heave: TCG release 2026-11-12; add it after that date.
